about: Taught passages: narrow doorways that are always taken along one line. The owner puts the robot on the line once; the robot gets onto it from `approach` m behind, then drives it straight for `length` at `speed`; from `tight_from` m on there is no room to settle onto the line. Coordinates are in the frame of your own map. Example entry: {"name": "corridor->kitchen", "start": [x, y, heading], "length": 1.9, "speed": 0.24, "approach": 0.4, "tight_from": 0.7, "gate": [x, y]}.
